meta.title: New password | Izacki
meta.description: Choose a new password for your Izacki account.

forumReset.title: New password
forumReset.lead: Choose the password you will use from now on on the site, on the forum and in the Launcher.
forumReset.sub: At least 6 characters. Type it twice to avoid a typo.
forumReset.updated: Password updated. You can now log in.
forumReset.errInvalidLink: This link is no longer valid (already used, or expired after about 1 hour). Request a new link from the “Forgot password” page.
forumReset.errMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
forumReset.errExpiredRetry: Invalid or expired link. Request a new link from the “Forgot password” page.
forumReset.errUpdateFailed: The password could not be updated. Try again.
